# Open UPI QR Generator

> Privacy-first UPI QR code generator that runs entirely in your browser. No login, no tracking, no server storage.

Open UPI QR Generator is a free, open-style web application that lets anyone create professional, fixed-amount UPI QR codes for receiving payments through any Indian UPI app (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Amazon Pay, Cred, and any NPCI UPI-compatible app). The tool is engineered for absolute privacy: all QR rendering, image generation, data validation, history storage, and template management happen inside the user's browser. No data is ever transmitted to a backend server, and no analytics or tracking scripts collect personal information.

The application is built and maintained by Charan Raj of CLP Studio. It is deployed at https://upiqrgenerator.lovable.app/ and is actively optimized for search engines, social sharing, and accessibility.

## What It Does

At its core, the generator takes five simple inputs — UPI ID, payee name, amount, payment note, and payment label — and produces a standards-compliant UPI deep link wrapped in a scannable QR code. The UPI URI is strictly formatted as:

`upi://pay?pa=<UPI_ID>&pn=<URL_ENCODED_NAME>&tn=<URL_ENCODED_NOTE>&cu=INR`

The `pa` parameter (UPI ID) is never URL-encoded, while `pn` and `tn` are encoded with `encodeURIComponent` to ensure compatibility with every major UPI app and prevent "upi_string invalid format" errors. A small branding suffix is optionally appended to the note: " - This QR Code Generated by upiqrgenerator.lovable.app build by CHARAN RAJ TECHY".

Users can customize the visual appearance of both the QR code itself and the surrounding payment card, then export the result as a high-resolution PNG, share it via the Web Share API, or scan-test it in a simulated overlay.

## Pages

- [Home](/): The main QR generator interface. Contains input fields, preset amount buttons, advanced options, live QR preview, export/share controls, and QR history.
- [Payment Page](/pay): A dedicated payment landing page that decodes UPI payment links for direct scanning.
- [Encoded Payment](/p/:data): A dynamic route that accepts base64-encoded payment data and renders a shareable payment page.
- [Not Found](/not-found, implicit): Clean 404 fallback with a return-to-home link.

## Core Features

### UPI QR Code Generation
- Real-time QR generation with 300ms debounce in Auto Generate mode.
- Strict UPI URI compliance: `upi://pay?pa=&pn=&tn=&cu=INR`.
- Input validation for UPI ID format (`name@bank` pattern).
- Amount validation (positive numbers only).
- Formatted amount preview in Indian Rupee notation (e.g., `₹1,50,000`).

### QR Visual Customization
- **Card Styles:** Four preset card layouts — Minimal, Bold Amount, Boxed, and Centered — that frame the QR code with payee details and amount.
- **QR Sizes:** Three export resolutions — Small (512px), Medium (1024px), and Large (2048px).
- **Finder Style:** Square (default), Rounded, or Custom finder patterns for the QR corner markers.
- **Module Style:** Square (default), Rounded, or Dots for the individual QR modules.
- **Logo Upload:** Users can upload a brand or personal logo to be embedded in the center of the QR code, leveraging high error-correction level "H" to remain scannable.
- **App Credit Toggle:** Optionally include a small builder credit line on the generated card.

### Templates & History
- **Save Template:** Persist UPI ID, payee name, and logo to localStorage for one-click future reuse.
- **Load Template:** Restore saved details instantly without retyping.
- **QR History:** Automatically stores generated QR codes in localStorage with full metadata (UPI ID, name, amount, note, label, card style, timestamp). Users can browse, reuse, or delete past entries.
- **Reset All:** One-click clearing of all localStorage data (templates, history, and style preferences) with a confirmation dialog.

### Export & Sharing
- **Download PNG:** Exports the styled payment card as a high-resolution PNG with solid white background for maximum scannability.
- **Share:** Uses the native Web Share API where available; falls back to automatic download if sharing is unsupported.
- **Copy Payment Details:** Copies a clean text summary (payee, UPI ID, amount, note) to the clipboard.
- **QR Scan Test:** Opens a modal with a simulated scanner overlay so users can verify their QR codes before distributing them.
- **Zoom Modal:** Enlarged lightbox view of the generated QR for detailed inspection.

### Safety & Quality
- **QR Safety Checker:** Live validation that warns if the QR contrast, quiet zone, or size might cause scanning failures. Ensures generated codes meet real-world readability standards.
- **High Error Correction:** All QRs use error correction level "H" (30% redundancy), allowing logos and styling without breaking scan reliability.

### User Experience
- **Auto Generate Toggle:** Let users choose between real-time QR updates or manual generation.
- **Preset Amounts:** One-tap buttons for common payment amounts (e.g., 100, 500, 1000, 5000).
- **Skeleton Loading:** Graceful loading state while the app initializes.
- **Toast Notifications:** Non-intrusive feedback for share, download, copy, and reset actions.
- **Dark Mode:** Full dark/light theme toggle with system preference detection and persistent storage.
- **Accessibility:** Semantic headings, ARIA labels on toggle switches (`role="switch"`, `aria-checked`), accessible social links with `aria-label`, and screen-reader-only section titles.

### Feedback & Discovery
- **Feature Request Modal:** In-app form for users to suggest new features or report issues directly to the developer.
- **Announcement Notifications:** Browser notification permission prompt for new feature rollouts (respects user preference and deduplicates via localStorage).
- **About Modal:** In-app credits, version information, and project philosophy.

## Technical Architecture

- **Stack:** React 18, TypeScript, Vite 6+, Tailwind CSS v3, shadcn/ui primitives, React Router, TanStack Query, and the `qrcode` npm library.
- **Rendering:** Custom QR renderer alongside the standard `qrcode` library for advanced finder/module styling. Payment cards are rendered as DOM elements and exported to PNG via HTML-to-image techniques or canvas composition.
- **State Management:** React hooks (`useState`, `useEffect`, `useCallback`, `useRef`) with `localStorage` as the only persistence layer.
- **Routing:** Three routes handled by React Router — `/`, `/pay`, `/p/:data`, and a catch-all `*` for 404s.
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS with a custom semantic design token system (`--background`, `--foreground`, `--primary`, `--card`, `--border`, etc.) supporting both light and dark modes via CSS variables.
- **Performance:** Debounced QR regeneration (300ms), lazy loading of heavy modals, and optimized re-renders with `useCallback`.
- **SEO:** Meta tags (title, description, Open Graph, Twitter Cards), canonical URL, JSON-LD structured data (SoftwareApplication + WebSite schemas), `robots.txt`, and `sitemap.xml`.

## Privacy & Security

- **100% Client-Side:** No backend API calls, no database, no authentication system, no cookies for tracking.
- **No Server Storage:** UPI IDs, names, amounts, notes, and generated images never leave the user's device.
- **LocalStorage Only:** Templates, history, theme preference, and settings are stored in the browser's `localStorage` and can be wiped at any time via the Reset All dialog.
- **No Third-Party Tracking:** No Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, or similar trackers are embedded.

## Supported UPI Apps

Generated QR codes and UPI deep links are tested and confirmed compatible with:
- Google Pay
- PhonePe
- Paytm
- BHIM
- Amazon Pay
- Cred
- Any NPCI UPI-compatible application
